The '''Sika Peninsula''' was a landmass jutting off the [[Encheeko/Legends|Encheeko]] continent of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]] into the [[Ioliu Sea]]. The city of [[Iskaayuma/Legends|Iskaayuma]] was located on the southeastern tip of the peninsula, built around [[Chattza Bay]]
